problem:
Suppose we wish to find a zero of the function $f(x,y)$ in the region $[-2,1]\times [-8,8]⊆{R}^{2},$ where

$$
f(x,y)=[\begin{aligned}{x}^{3}y-x-1 \\ x{y}^{2}-2y+2\end{aligned}].
$$

Calculate the second iteration of the Newton-Raphson process that starts at ${x}_{0}=[1,\,1]^{T}$ if the first iteration of the algorithm gives ${x}_{1}=[0,\,4]^{T}.$ Round your final answer to three decimal places (if needed).

feedback.problem:
Suppose we wish to find a zero of the function $f(x,y)$ in the region $[0,2]\times [-1,1]⊆{R}^{2},$ where

$$
f(x,y)=[\begin{aligned}x+{y}^{3}+3xy-4 \\ {x}^{3}+y-2\end{aligned}].
$$

Calculate the second iteration of the Newton-Raphson process that starts at ${x}_{0}=[1,\,-1]^{T}$ if the first iteration of the algorithm gives ${x}_{1}=[1.25,\,0.25]^{T}.$ Round your final answer to three decimal places (if needed).

| ${x}_{2}\,≈[$ | $1.095$ | $]$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| {{field-1}} |  |  |
feedback.worked_solution:
The Newton-Raphson method of finding the zeros of a multivariable function $f:{R}^{n}\to {R}^{n}$ is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-[{J}_{f}({x}_{n})]^{-1}f({x}_{n}),
$$

where ${J}_{f}({x}_{n})$ is the Jacobian of $f$ evaluated at ${x}_{n}.$

In our case, the Jacobian is

$$
\begin{aligned}{J}_{f}(x) & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂x}(x+{y}^{3}+3xy-4) & \frac{∂}{∂y}(x+{y}^{3}+3xy-4) \\ \frac{∂}{∂x}({x}^{3}+y-2) & \frac{∂}{∂y}({x}^{3}+y-2)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1+3y & 3{y}^{2}+3x \\ 3{x}^{2} & 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our Newton-Raphson formula is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-{[\begin{aligned}1+3y & 3{y}^{2}+3x \\ 3{x}^{2} & 1\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}^{-1}{[\begin{aligned}x+{y}^{3}+3xy-4 \\ {x}^{3}+y-2\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}.
$$

For the second iteration, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & ={x}_{1}-{[\begin{aligned}1+3y & 3{y}^{2}+3x \\ 3{x}^{2} & 1\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{1}}^{-1}{[\begin{aligned}x+{y}^{3}+3xy-4 \\ {x}^{3}+y-2\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{1}} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1.25 \\ 0.25\end{aligned}]-{[\begin{aligned}1+3(0.25) & 3(0.25)^{2}+3(1.25) \\ 3(1.25)^{2} & 1\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}1.25+(0.25)^{3}+3(1.25)(0.25)-4 \\ (1.25)^{3}+0.25-2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1.25 \\ 0.25\end{aligned}]-{[\begin{aligned}1.75 & 3.9375 \\ 4.6875 & 1\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}-1.796875 \\ 0.203125\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1.25 \\ 0.25\end{aligned}]-\frac{1}{1.75\cdot 1-3.9375\cdot 4.6875}[\begin{aligned}1 & -3.9375 \\ -4.6875 & 1.75\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1.796\,875 \\ 0.203\,125\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1.25 \\ 0.25\end{aligned}]+\frac{1}{16.707\,031…}[\begin{aligned}-2.596\,679… \\ 8.778\,320…\end{aligned}] \\  & ≈[\begin{aligned}1.095 \\ 0.775\end{aligned}],\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to three decimal places.
